summary: Report a stalled run that names no report-to by default, to its requesting agent or to an agent the stuck agent is under

schema.detail: No persistent schema or claim vocabulary changes. Default reports are ordinary daemon/runtime messages with the existing st3-run-report tags and idempotency keys.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A run with no report-to now sends one stalled message per silence after 30 minutes: to its requester when that is an agent, else to the first running agent that a stuck agent is under. Failures, cancellations and completions still go only to a named reporter. A silence already past its limit when the daemon starts, or when the default is turned on in the config, is not reported, so an upgrade sends no burst. `missions report-to RUN --clear` on a run that never named a reporter now writes a mission-run.report-to claim, which also stops the default; an older member reads that claim as reporting to nobody, as before. [reconcile] gains default_stall_reports (default true); a config that sets it fails to load on an older build, because [reconcile] denies unknown fields.

downtime.detail: No migration. The default stall deadline is armed in the existing incremental run evaluation and only for runs with a stuck agent and a default reporter.

manual.detail: On by default. Turn it off with default_stall_reports = false under [reconcile]; the daemon reads it again within two minutes. Opt one run out with `fractal missions report-to RUN --clear`. The guide is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Run reports.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary after removing default_stall_reports from the config. Default reports stop; messages already sent stay in the graph.
